summary: OUTFRONT Media Inc. filed an 8-K on May 7, 2026, to announce its first quarter 2026 financial results and a quarterly cash dividend of $0.30 per share. The filing under Items 2.02 and 8.01 reports routine operating performance and a regular dividend declaration. No merger, acquisition, restructuring, or special-situation event is disclosed. The dividend is payable on June 30, 2026, to holders of record on June 5, 2026. This is a standard earnings release and dividend announcement, not a special situation.
